notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Coffers does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Swamps.
description:
Activate Magus of the Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {2}{B} due to Blood Funnel.
Blood Funnel triggers, causing you to sacrifice Magus of the Coffers.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Magus of the Coffers from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Swamps, this combo nets infinite black mana.
